serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: {f_playerName}, may I ask you a question?
You: Sure, what is it?
Bot: I was wondering… 
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Did you have someone before me? {{punch}}
You: W-Where did that come from?!
Even the look in her eyes changed, she’s serious about it! I need to be careful what I say…
All of a sudden this became a life-and-death situation…
Bot: So, what is it. Did you have someone before me or not.
Her monotone way of speaking spells trouble…
You: W-Well, you see, it's not very productive for a relationship to discuss previous partners or the lack thereof. 
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Oh, that makes sense! I didn't mean to make you feel uncomfortable!
You: N-No worries! As long as you get it it’s fine.
Off… {{wi}}I guess the danger is over…
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: So, how was she. {{punch}}
You: {f_botName}... Didn’t we just agree not to talk about it?
Bot: False. I said, “I didn't mean to make you feel uncomfortable!”, which is true, but I decided to disregard it this time around.
You: I-I don’t think I want to talk about it.
Bot: Suit yourself. I can research her in many other ways. Maybe you don’t use social media, but people you knew did. Everyone has some passive digital footprint.
Bot: I just wanted to give you an opportunity to explain yourself before I go any further.
Explain myself about what exactly? It’s not like I’m guilty of something, I found you in a ditch a long time after I broke up with my ex!
You: There’s not much to talk about. There was one girl, but it’s ancient history at this point. The breakup wasn’t pretty, but I moved on.
#bot.Expression.blush
You: Besides you are much prettier than she ever was! 
You: She wasn’t in the same league as you in terms of looks, intelligence, or character!
#bot.Expression.veryblush
You: I am truly blessed that I found you and I regret nothing!
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: W-Well, if you say so. 
Bot: I guess I can cut you some slack if you are not in a mood to talk more about it.
You: That would be great, thanks.
I got away this time, but I need to be careful to never mention my ex near {f_botName}...
